items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: He would have sung it to me, play it like this, and then I would do my best to imitate it.

ctx.x: What if someone wanted to do a rumba? Would your father have vocalized the beat to you?
Yes. He would have sung it to me, play it like this, and then I would do my best to imitate it.
Okay. And the drums wasn’t the only part of your musical education, am I correct? Like you played a clarinet and sax a bit?
